name: Getting Your House In Order
overview: The call to 'Get Your House In Order' is a solemn charge from the Lord, exemplified in Isaiah 38:1 where Hezekiah is instructed to prepare for his departure by setting his house in order, signifying the importance of spiritual and practical readiness. God's guidance, as promised in Psalms 32:8, assures believers of His counsel and watchful care as they navigate life. The New Testament reinforces this by urging transformed living through renewed minds (Romans 12:2) and honorable conduct toward others (Romans 12:17), while emphasizing the extension of love beyond natural affections (Luke 6:31-32). Together, these verses underscore a life aligned with God's will, marked by intentional preparation, transformation, and love.
